note: spec 01 §15.3. reader_state defaults: K_1 only, epoch_hwm 1, server current_epoch 1, W pinned at counter 1 (the anchor frame A09). Each page is what the server serves; rows are chained and, where a case does not vary it, head-signed by W so that the case isolates the check it names. reader is spec 01 §6.6's result (rows opened in order; hard_stop names the row that stopped the page). upload, where present, is POST /api/v1/sync into an account holding the anchor frame at counter 1 under W, with W bound to the session, and verdict is the answer. Ops in the plaintexts follow 03c's envelope; the reader knows reader_known_op_types at reader_schema.
